lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Border Station Four is under coordinated raider assault.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: This one is real. Protect the personnel first.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Finally, an order that makes sense.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Let us see whether the attackers do.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Outpost holds. Get the wounded inside.

lines.speaker: broadcast
lines.text: A massive offensive was shattered by Aldric’s vigilant defense network.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Four attackers. No reserve, no extraction plan, matching serial mounts.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Real people needed us. That does not make the report honest.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: We are losing the station. Fall back and try again before the wounded are trapped.

midBattle.speaker: vale
midBattle.text: Hold the approach. Reyes, keep the station side covered.

midBattle.speaker: kell
midBattle.text: Matching government-format mounting plates. Somebody standardized these “raiders.”

midBattle.speaker: vale
midBattle.text: They came in without supplies or an escape route. Who attacks like this?

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: That repair drone is government issue with the crest ground off.
